results.question: How many days of annual leave do employees get?
results.answer: Employees receive 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, in addition to public holidays. (Source 1 and Source 2)

results.question: What is the sick leave policy?
results.answer: I don't have enough information to answer this question based on the available documents.

results.question: Can I work remotely full-time?
results.answer: Yes, eligible employees may work remotely full-time depending on their role, department requirements, and manager approval. Employees are expected to maintain reliable internet access, attend virtual meetings, and comply with company security policies while working remotely. (Source 1, Source 2)

results.question: How do I request time off?
results.answer: You should submit your leave requests through the HR portal and get approval from your manager in advance. (Source 1 and Source 2)
